name: swarmlord
description: Claude Code orchestrates many CLI coding agents. Claude picks the best CLI agent for each task from user-configurable routing rules (config/routing.json), runs it headlessly in its own git worktree, verifies the result against the filesystem and tests, and can hand off between agents mid-task — with a ledger-backed circuit breaker that pauses on state recurrence, repeated errors, cross-agent reverts, and budget overruns. Adapters: Codex, Kiro, Copilot, Gemini, OpenCode, Command Code, Muse Code, Antigravity, Aider, Goose, and local LLMs (Ollama / LM Studio / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

default_agent.title: Default agent
default_agent.description: Agent id (from config/agents.json) used when a delegation names no agent and routing is not applied. Leave empty to route by task type via config/routing.json.

timeout.title: Default per-run timeout
timeout.description: Wall-clock bound for one delegated run, e.g. 5m, 10m, 300s. A run that exceeds it is killed and classified as a timeout.

coding_policy.title: Inject routing policy at session start
coding_policy.description: When on, a SessionStart hook injects the SwarmLord routing policy (delegate above the break-even, verify everything, respect the circuit breaker) as session context. Set to off/false/0/no to suppress.

delegation_nudge.title: Nudge delegation on bulk-looking prompts
delegation_nudge.description: When on, a UserPromptSubmit hook adds a short advisory note when a prompt looks like bulk work above the delegation break-even. Advisory only — the break-even judgment stays with Claude.

local_url.title: Local LLM endpoint (local adapter)
local_url.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint for the `local` adapter, e.g. http://localhost:11434 (Ollama) or http://localhost:1234 (LM Studio).

local_model.title: Local LLM model (local adapter)
local_model.description: Model id the local adapter asks the endpoint for. Must be a model your endpoint actually serves.
